text_en: As we work together with him, we urge you also not to accept the grace of God in vain.
text_cn: 我们与天主合作的人，也劝你们不要白受天主的恩宠──

text_en: For he says, “At an acceptable time I have listened to you, and on a day of salvation I have helped you. ” See, now is the acceptable time; see, now is the day of salvation!
text_cn: 因为经上说：“在悦纳的时候，我俯允了你；在救恩的时日，我帮助了你。”看！如今正是悦纳的时候；看！如今正是救恩的时日──

text_en: We are putting no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no fault may be found with our ministry,
text_cn: 我们在任何事上，为避免这职务受诋毁，不但没有给任何人跌倒的因由，

text_en: but as servants of God we have commended ourselves in every way: through great endurance, in afflictions, hardships, calamities,
text_cn: 反而处处表现我们自己，有如天主的仆役，就是以持久的坚忍，在艰难、贫乏、困苦之中，

text_en: beatings, imprisonments, riots, labors, sleepless nights, hunger;
text_cn: 在拷打、监禁、暴乱之中，在劳苦、不寝、不食之中，

text_en: by purity, knowledge, patience, kindness, holiness of spirit, genuine love,
text_cn: 以清廉，以明智，以容忍，以慈惠，以圣神，以无伪的爱情，

text_en: truthful speech, and the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness for the right hand and for the left;
text_cn: 以真理的言辞，以天主的德能，以左右两手中正义的武器，

text_en: in honor and dishonor, in ill repute and good repute. We are treated as impostors, and yet are true;
text_cn: 历经光荣和凌辱，恶名和美名；像是迷惑人的，却是真诚的；

text_en: as unknown, and yet are well known; as dying, and see—we are alive; as punished, and yet not killed;
text_cn: 像是人所不知的，却是人所共知的；像是待死的，看！我们却活着；像是受惩罚的，却没有被置于死地；

text_en: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
text_cn: 像是忧苦的，却常常喜乐；像是贫困的，却使许多人富足；像是一无所有的，却无所不有。

text_en: We have spoken frankly to you Corinthians; our heart is wide open to you.
text_cn: 格林多人啊！我们的口向你们张开了，我们的心也敞开了。

text_en: There is no restriction in our affections, but only in yours.
text_cn: 你们在我们心内并不窄狭，而是你们的心肠窄狭。

text_en: In return—I speak as to children—open wide your hearts also.
text_cn: 为了以报还报，如今我对你们犹如对自己的孩子说：你们也敞开你们的心吧！

text_en: Do not be mismatched with unbelievers. For what partnership is there between righteousness and lawlessness? Or what fellowship is there between light and darkness?
text_cn: 你们不要与不信的人共负一轭（è），因为正义与不法之间，那能有什么相通？或者，光明之于黑暗，那能有什么联系？

text_en: What agreement does Christ have with Beliar? Or what does a believer share with an unbeliever?
text_cn: 基督之于贝里雅耳，那能有什么协和？或者，信者与不信者，那能有什么股份？

text_en: What agreement has the temple of God with idols? For we are the temple of the living God; as God said, “I will live in them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
text_cn: 天主的殿与偶像，那能有什么相合？的确，我们就是生活的天主的殿，正如天主所说的：“我要在他们内居住，我要在他们中徘徊；我要做他们的天主，他们要做我的百姓。”

text_en: Therefore come out from them, and be separate from them, says the Lord, and touch nothing unclean; then I will welcome you,
text_cn: 为此，“你们应当从他们中间出来，离开他们──这是上主说的──你们不可触摸不洁之物，我要收纳你们，

text_en: and I will be your father, and you shall be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty. ”
text_cn: 我要做你们的父亲，你们要做我的子女：这是全能的上主说的。”
